labelChirho: centurion, Roman officer commanding one hundred soldiers
descriptionChirho: A Roman military officer in charge of a centuria (nominally 100 soldiers), a mid-ranking commander in the Roman army; rendered 'centurion' (eng), 'centurión' (spa), 'सूबेदार' (hin), 'قائد المئة/قوّاد المئات' (arb), '백부장' (kor), 'akida/jemadari' (swa). All 21 occurrences across nominative, dative, accusative singular, genitive singular, and plural forms denote the same military rank with purely inflectional variation. No semantic distinction exists between the singular and plural clusters.
